what: spec_context_v58.json under bot v58 (2026-10-18). Everything in chains/spec_chain.json, spec_context.json, spec_context_v55.json and spec_context_v58.json holds, except where the rules below say otherwise. The labels of 'orders' are spec_v58.json's (47 intents, the same as spec_v57.json's). Written after the owner's play with bot v58 and the end-to-end runs of 2026-10-18: a line that said to go up some stairs and then to jump was read as one move (the bot never jumped); a move up followed by a check, and a move and then getting into and out of a car, became one order; after a few shots and then a move, a correction to the pin was written as a shot at the pin, not a move.
rules: 9. A movement that names its own way, side or place ('go up', 'move up', 'head up the ramp', 'move left', 'go down the red stairs', 'go to my pin', 'get to the truck') followed by ANOTHER action is two orders, the movement first, even when the action says 'there' or 'up there': 'head up the ramp and jump down' = ['Head up the ramp.', 'Jump down.'] (MOVE_TO, JUMP); 'move left and check' = ['Move left.', 'Check.'] (MOVE_TO, CHECK); 'go down and check there' = ['Go down.', 'Check there.'] (MOVE_TO, CHECK); 'go to my pin and crouch' = ['Go to my pin.', 'Crouch.'] (MOVE_TO, CROUCH); 'get to the truck and shoot that window' = ['Get to the truck.', 'Shoot that window.'] (MOVE_TO, OPEN_FIRE); 'hop in the truck and then hop out' = ['Hop in the truck.', 'Hop out of the truck.'] (GET_IN, GET_OUT). Rule 3 of spec_chain.json still keeps ONE order where the movement is the action's own way of being done or the action is staying or hiding at the place the movement names: 'go around the back and hit them from behind' = [FLANK]; 'push in and clear the room' = [ENTRY]; 'go upstairs and stay there' = [HOLD_POSITION]; 'go to the sofa and hide behind it' = [TAKE_COVER] (behind the very place the movement names); 'get down and find cover' = [TAKE_COVER] ('get down' is ducking, no movement). Cover found after a move is two orders: 'head down the ramp and take cover' = ['Head down the ramp.', 'Take cover.'] (MOVE_TO, TAKE_COVER); so is a stance: 'move left and sit down' = ['Move left.', 'Sit down.'] (MOVE_TO, CROUCH). A bare 'go' or 'come on' in front of an order is no movement of its own: 'go check the basement' = [CHECK]; 'go reload' = [RELOAD].

3b. A correction (a 'no' with a place, or a place alone: 'no, at my pin', 'on my pin', 'over there', 'no, the other one') is for the LAST order, the one said just before it, even when the earlier lines gave another order more often: before: ['open fire', 'shoot there', 'move up']; line: 'no, at my pin' -> 'Move up to my pin.' (MOVE_TO). before: ['go left', 'move up', 'open fire']; line: 'over there' -> 'Open fire over there.' (OPEN_FIRE). before: ['smoke the door', 'smoke the stairs', 'hold the window']; line: 'no, the other one' -> 'Hold the other window.' (HOLD_ANGLE). A line the bot answered with a question ('Where?', 'Which window?') is still the last order.
